import re
import zlib
import numpy as np

# all-MiniLM-L6-v2 needs PyTorch and a model download, which this sandbox cannot do.
# encode() is an offline stand-in with the same output shape: a unit-length
# 384-dimensional vector. It only "understands" shared words (each word is hashed
# to one dimension); the real model also matches synonyms and meaning.
def encode(text, dim=384):
    vec = np.zeros(dim)
    for word in re.findall(r"[a-z]+", text.lower()):
        vec[zlib.crc32(word.encode()) % dim] += 1.0
    norm = np.linalg.norm(vec)
    return vec / norm if norm else vec


def similarity(a, b):
    """Return the cosine similarity between two sentences as a float."""
    va, vb = encode(a), encode(b)
    return float(np.dot(va, vb) / (np.linalg.norm(va) * np.linalg.norm(vb)))


print("embedding shape:", encode("hello world").shape)
close = similarity("I love programming in Python", "Coding in Python is my passion")
far = similarity("I love programming in Python", "The weather is rainy today")
print(None if close is None else round(close, 3), None if far is None else round(far, 3))
